dialogues.speaker: Ku
dialogues.text: Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! You're just in time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Ku
dialogues.text: Ow, ow, ow, think I sprained my ankle...

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Big Brother Ku's hurt again. Could you please help us make offerings at the Perch?

choices.text: You know, I have to admit that I expected this development...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you worry about a thing! We've got this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, right! Aren't you very sensitive to the elements and all, Ruu?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't you do that yourself?

response.speaker: Ruu
response.text: Uh... So, I did try before in previous ceremonies, but it didn't turn out so well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah well. Guess we're handling this perch business.

choices.text: Then I'll do it in your stead.
We'll leave the injured person to you.

dialogues.speaker: Ku
dialogues.text: Ugh, what an embarrassment... I just hope this won't affect the ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Ku
dialogues.text: I wouldn't know how to face you if it does, Ruu.

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Oh, don't be like that! You've always been so nice to me!

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Please help us with the Perch!

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: I'll stay here with Big Brother Ku.

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Ooh, the Perch is all lit up now!

dialogues.speaker: Ku
dialogues.text: Guess that's that done. Sorry, I imagine that it was pretty rough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! We're specialist problem solvers, don'cha know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not that different from the Light Actuating Ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Going to three spots to fix three smaller problems to solve a larger issue...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like we've had this happen to us a lot, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: I don't really understand a lot of what you said, but the adults do have this saying...

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: They call it "The Rule of Three."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Well, I guess they just mean that you need to do things thrice in order to get a result.

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: For example, they say that "good omens must occur three times for good fortune to truly descend"... Same for bad omens.

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: They also say that "you must forge past obstacles three times to succeed on the fourth."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But isn't that more like the "Rule of Four," then?

dialogues.speaker: Ruu
dialogues.text: Huh, that's true! You're really good at numbers, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, of course!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, are you sure Ku will be fine?

response.speaker: Ruu
response.text: Don't worry, he's always like this.

response.speaker: Ku
response.text: Ugh, what an embarrassment... I just hope this won't affect the ceremony.

response.speaker: Ku
response.text: I wouldn't know how to face you if it does, Ruu.

response.speaker: Ruu
response.text: Oh, don't be like that! You've always been so nice to me!

response.speaker: Ruu
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two go ahead first!

response.speaker: Ruu
response.text: I'll stay here with Big Brother Ku. We'll take charge of the cleanup work once you're done with the offering!

choices.text: How's Ku's injury, by the way?
